sn35.246:1.1: yassa kassa ci bhikkhave bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu uppajjeyya chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vā cetaso, tato cittaṃ nivāraye,
sn35.246:1.2: sabhayo ceso maggo sappaṭibhayo ca sakaṇṭako ca sagahano ca ummaggo ca kummaggo ca duhitiko ca.
sn35.246:1.3: asappurisasevito ceso maggo na ceso maggo sappurisehi sevito.
sn35.246:1.6: yassa kassaci bhikkhave bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā sotaviññeyyesu saddesu …pe… ghānaviññeyyesu gandhesu …pe… jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu …pe… kāyaviññeyyesu phoṭṭhabbesu …pe…
sn35.246:1.7: manoviññeyyesu dhammesu uppajjeyya chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vā cetaso, tato cittaṃ nivāraye.
sn35.246:1.8: sabhayo ceso maggo sappaṭibhayo ca sakaṇṭako ca sagahano ca ummaggo ca kummaggo ca duhitiko ca.
sn35.246:1.9: asappurisasevito ceso maggo, na ceso maggo sappurisehi sevito.
sn35.246:1.11: tato cittaṃ nivāraye mano viññeyyehi dhammehi.
sn35.246:2.2: kiṭṭharakkhakoca pamatto goṇo ca kiṭṭhādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otaritvā yāvadatthaṃ madaṃ āpajjeyya,
sn35.246:2.3: evameva kho bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano chasu phassāyatanesu asaṃvutakārī pañcasu kāmaguṇesu yāvadatthaṃ madaṃ āpajjati.
sn35.246:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kiṭṭhaṃ sampannaṃ kiṭṭharakkhako ca appamatto goṇo ca kiṭṭhādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otareyya
sn35.246:3.3: nāsāya suggahitaṃ gahetvā uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya.
sn35.246:3.4: uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷeyya.
sn35.246:3.7: tatiyampi kho bhikkhave goṇo kiṭṭhādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otareyya.
sn35.246:3.9: nāsāya suggahitaṃ gahetvā uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya.
sn35.246:3.10: uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷeyya.
sn35.246:3.12: hi so bhikkhave goṇo kiṭṭhādo gāmagato vā araññagato vā ṭhāna bahulo assa nisajjabahulo, na taṃ kiṭṭhaṃ puna otareyya.
sn35.246:3.14: evameva kho bhikkhave yato bhikkhuno chasu phassāyatanesu cittaṃ udujjitaṃ hoti sudujjitaṃ ajjhattaṃ santiṭṭhati, sannisīdati, ekodi hoti, samādhiyati.
sn35.246:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño vā rājamahāmattassa vā vīṇāya saddo assutapubbo assa.
sn35.246:4.4: “ambho, kissanukho eso saddo evaṃ rajanīyo evaṃ kamanīyo evaṃ madanīyo evaṃ mucchanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo”ti?
sn35.246:4.6: “esā kho bhante vīṇā nāma yassā eso saddo evaṃ rajanīyo evaṃ kamanīyo evaṃ madanīyo evaṃ mucchanīyo evaṃ bandhanīyo”ti.
sn35.246:4.11: “ayaṃ kho sā bhante, vīṇā yassā eso saddo evaṃ rajanīyo evaṃ kamanīyo evaṃ madanīyo evaṃ mucchanīyo evaṃ bandhanīyo”ti.
sn35.246:4.13: “alaṃ me bho tāya vīṇāya, tameva me saddaṃ āharathā”ti.
sn35.246:4.15: “ayaṃ kho bhante vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā.
sn35.246:4.17: doṇiñca paṭicca cammañca paṭicca daṇḍañca paṭicca upaveṇañca paṭicca tantiyo ca paṭicca koṇañca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca evāyaṃ bhante vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā.
sn35.246:4.19: so taṃ vīṇaṃ dasadhā vā satadhā vā phāleyya, dasadhā vā satadhā vā taṃ phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya.
sn35.246:4.20: sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā agginā ḍaheyya, agginā ḍahetvā masiṃ kareyya.
sn35.246:4.21: masiṃ karitvā mahāvāte vā opuneyya, nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya.
sn35.246:4.23: asatī kirāyaṃ bho vīṇā nāma, yathevaṃ yaṃ kiñci vīṇā nāma, ettha ca panāyaṃ jano ativelaṃ pamatto palāḷitoti.
sn35.246:4.24: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu rūpaṃ samannesati yāvatā rūpassa gati. vedanaṃ samannesati yāvatā vedanāya gati, saññaṃ samannesati yāvatā saññāya gati, saṅkhāre samannesati yāvatā saṅkhārānaṃ gati, viññāṇaṃ samannesati yāvatā viññāṇassa gati.
sn35.246:4.25: tassa rūpaṃ samannesato yāvatā rūpassa gati. vedanaṃ …pe…
sn35.246:4.29: yampissa taṃ hoti ahanti vā mamanti vā asmīti vā tampi tassa na hotīti.
